key_insight: C-MIG enhances retrieval-augmented generation in clinical diagnosis by addressing reward signal loss and credit assignment in reinforcement learning.
clinical_relevance: The framework aims to improve the accuracy and reliability of clinical diagnosis by intelligently guiding discourse within large language models.
method: Utilizes Multi-view Information Gain for retrieval augmentation.
Implements a multi-subquery retrieval strategy for better knowledge recall.
Estimates information gain from both retrieved documents and document refinement.
evidence_signal: Comprehensive experiments demonstrate C-MIG's superior performance on medical benchmarks compared to existing RAG-RL methods.
watch_item: Limited by dependency on a frozen reference model for estimating information gain.
paper_title: C-MIG: Multi-view Information Gain-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Diagnosis Reasoning
